runtime_support_by_benchmark.spectralnorm: Nim arrays, numeric operations, ordinary native threads and ORC; authored coefficient, dense products, transpose and iteration loops.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.mandelbrot: Nim numeric operations, row buffers, ordinary native threads and ORC; authored full complex recurrence and PBM/tail output.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.fasta: Nim buffers/IO and ORC; authored repeat emission, every prescribed LCG transition and floating cumulative-probability selection.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.knucleotide: Nim standard growing Tables, strings/IO, ordinary native threads and ORC; all seven complete maps and every window update remain authored work.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.binarytrees: Nim reference objects, ORC, native threads and IO; actual separately allocated interior and leaf nodes, recursive checks and retained long-lived root.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.nbody: Nim numeric/array operations and ORC; authored momentum, all pair forces/position steps and both energy calculations.
runtime_support_by_benchmark.fannkuchredux: Nim arrays, numeric operations, ordinary native threads and ORC; authored factoradic permutation enumeration, actual prefix flips and checksum.

timing_boundary: Three complete sequential fresh native processes per exact source in rotated rounds, with fresh unchanged Mech AOT controls. Includes process startup, canonical input, all prescribed computation, full stdout and teardown. Compilation, qualification and validation hashes are outside timing. Native/compiler/QA work uses one common mutex, AC power and Low Power Mode off, at most eight compute workers and fixed time/RSS limits.
source_provenance: Twenty locally adapted compact/optimized Nim applications retain immutable community provenance and the prescribed CLBG algorithms. Every actual compiler-loaded authored main/helper/ABI glue file is counted in its reviewed source bundle; generic vendor runtime/packages are separately pinned. Successful original bounded results retain their original source, binary and build ancestry. No upstream or rejected performance sample is reused and no domain host kernel is introduced.
